def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            cells={(r,c)}; seen.add((r,c)); stack=[(r,c)]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop()
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    p=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=p[0]<h and 0<=p[1]<w and p not in seen and grid[p[0]][p[1]]==color:
                        seen.add(p); cells.add(p); stack.append(p)
            objs.append((color,cells))
    objs.sort(key=lambda obj:max(x for y,x in obj[1]),reverse=True)
    occupied=set()
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for color,cells in objs:
        shift=0
        while True:
            d=shift+1
            if any(x+d>=w or (y,x+d) in occupied for y,x in cells): break
            shift=d
        moved={(y,x+shift) for y,x in cells}
        for y,x in moved: out[y][x]=color
        occupied.update(moved)
    return out
